_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 7. Blau notes consulted: 7:2 (ויהי הגשם → 'ויהי = continued/persisted'), 7:4 (אלאנאם — 'the people' for היקום, Blau 7:4), 7:11 (אלגמר אלעצ'אם — Cairo follows Tag/Kapach plural; Blau prefers sing.), 7:15 (דכ'לו vs אקבלו ms variants — Cairo follows Kapach), 7:17 (אקאם — 'continued' for ויהי), 7:23 (וימחו pl. clarifies subject as המים).

translations.1: And God said to Noah: 'Enter, you and all your household, into the ark; for I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.
translations.2: Of every pure beast you shall take seven by seven, males and females; and of the beasts that are not pure, a pair — male and female.
translations.3: And also of the bird of the sky, seven by seven, males and females — that they may live upon the face of the earth.
translations.4: For after seven days I shall rain upon the earth, forty days and forty nights; and I shall wipe away all the people whom I have made from the face of the earth.'
translations.5: And Noah did according to all that God had commanded him.
translations.6: And Noah was a son of six hundred years when the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
translations.7: And Noah entered, with his sons, and his wife and his sons' wives with him, into the ark — before the waters of the flood.
translations.8: Of the pure beasts, and of the beasts that were not pure, and of the bird, and the rest of what creeps upon the earth —
translations.9: in pairs, pairs they entered to Noah, into the ark — males and females — as God had commanded him.
translations.10: And when it was after seven days, the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
translations.11: In the six-hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of it — on that day, all the great springs of the deep burst open, and the windows of the sky were opened.
translations.12: And the rain continued upon the earth, forty days and forty nights.
translations.13: On that very day Noah entered — with Shem and Ham and Japheth his sons, and his wife and the three wives of his sons with them — into the ark.
translations.14: They, and all the wild creatures according to their kinds, and all the beasts according to their kinds, and the rest of the creeping things, that which creeps upon the earth, according to its kinds; and every winged bird.
translations.15: And they entered to Noah, into the ark, in pairs, pairs of every corporeal being in which is the breath of life.
translations.16: And those who entered — males and females of every corporeal being — entered, as God had commanded him; and God shut him in.
translations.17: And when the flood had continued forty days upon the earth, the water multiplied, and bore up the ark, and it rose above the earth.
translations.18: And when the water grew mighty and multiplied greatly upon the earth, the ark went upon the face of the water.
translations.19: And the water grew mighty exceedingly upon the earth; and all the lofty mountains beneath the whole of the sky were covered.
translations.20: And when the water grew mighty fifteen cubits above the earth, the mountains were covered.
translations.21: Every corporeal being that crept upon the earth perished — from the bird to the beast to the wild creatures, and the rest of the creeping things that creep upon the earth — and all the people.
translations.22: Every one in whose nostril was the breath of the spirit of life — of all who were on the dry land — they died.
translations.23: And the water wiped away all the people who were upon the face of the earth — from human to beast, to creeping thing, and to bird of the sky — and they were wiped from the earth; and there remained only Noah, and those with him in the ark.
translations.24: And the water grew mighty upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
